text:
Laptop fails POST after a RAM upgrade
Applies to: Dell laptops. Category: hardware / memory.
Symptom: Power is present but startup fails after memory replacement
Possible causes (not confirmed): Incompatible or incorrectly installed RAM
Resolution:
1. Record model and diagnostic lights
2. Check upgrade compatibility in the exact service manual
3. Have a qualified person check installation with power isolated and ESD precautions
Verify: Manufacturer logo and normal startup return
Escalate: Soldered memory or continued failure requires service
Source: https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000141584/how-to-troubleshoot-a-no-post-issue-on-a-dell-notebook-pc

metadata.title: Laptop fails POST after a RAM upgrade

text:
Laptop fails POST after physical damage
Applies to: Dell laptops. Category: hardware / motherboard.
Symptom: No normal startup after a drop or spill
Possible causes (not confirmed): Physical damage
Resolution:
1. Record what happened
2. Stop repeated startup attempts if damage is apparent
3. Arrange manufacturer assessment
Verify: Technician confirms safe startup
Escalate: Visible damage or liquid exposure requires service
Source: https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000141584/how-to-troubleshoot-a-no-post-issue-on-a-dell-notebook-pc

metadata.title: Laptop fails POST after physical damage

text:
Laptop overheats and shuts down
Applies to: Dell laptops. Category: hardware / cooling.
Symptom: Heat and unexpected shutdown under load
Possible causes (not confirmed): Restricted cooling or fan fault
Resolution:
1. Use a hard ventilated surface
2. Reduce workload
3. Run model-supported preboot fan diagnostics
Verify: Normal workload completes without shutdown
Escalate: Persistent overheating or failed fan diagnostic requires service
Source: https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000130867/how-to-troubleshoot-a-overheating-shutdown-or-thermal-issue-on-a-dell-pc

metadata.title: Laptop overheats and shuts down

text:
Laptop fan runs loudly all the time
Applies to: Dell laptops with Windows. Category: hardware / cooling.
Symptom: Continuous high fan speed
Possible causes (not confirmed): High CPU load or restricted airflow
Resolution:
1. Check Task Manager for sustained CPU load
2. Close unnecessary workload
3. Check vents and follow model cleaning instructions
Verify: Fan settles after workload drops
Escalate: Abnormal fan behavior at idle requires support
Source: https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000130867/how-to-troubleshoot-a-overheating-shutdown-or-thermal-issue-on-a-dell-pc

metadata.title: Laptop fan runs loudly all the time

text:
Laptop chassis or trackpad is bulging
Applies to: Dell laptops. Category: hardware / battery_safety.
Symptom: Swelling or lifted keyboard or trackpad
Possible causes (not confirmed): Possible battery fault
Resolution:
1. Power off
2. Disconnect external power if safe
3. Stop using the device
4. Contact authorized service without opening or pressing the battery
Verify: Authorized technician assesses and resolves fault
Escalate: Escalate immediately; do not continue normal troubleshooting
Source: https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000130867/how-to-troubleshoot-a-overheating-shutdown-or-thermal-issue-on-a-dell-pc

metadata.title: Laptop chassis or trackpad is bulging

text:
Windows cannot connect to Wi-Fi
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / networking.
Symptom: Wireless connection fails
Possible causes (not confirmed): Wireless disabled or network configuration issue
Resolution:
1. Check Wi-Fi and airplane mode
2. Check the selected network
3. Run the Windows network troubleshooter
Verify: Reconnect and open a known website
Escalate: Escalate with adapter model and exact error
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/connectivity-networking/fix-wi-fi-connection-issues-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows cannot connect to Wi-Fi

text:
Windows shows Wi-Fi connected but no internet
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / networking.
Symptom: Connected wireless icon but internet unavailable
Possible causes (not confirmed): Router or internet service or network settings
Resolution:
1. Check connection status
2. Compare another device on the same network
3. Run the network troubleshooter
Verify: Internet access returns on affected laptop
Escalate: If multiple devices fail contact network administrator or ISP
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/connectivity-networking/fix-wi-fi-connection-issues-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows shows Wi-Fi connected but no internet

text:
Windows camera works in one app only
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / camera_permissions.
Symptom: Camera preview works but meeting app fails
Possible causes (not confirmed): App permissions or app settings
Resolution:
1. Check Windows camera access for the affected app
2. Check desktop app permission where applicable
3. Select the camera in the meeting app
Verify: Preview works inside the affected app
Escalate: Managed permission policy requires IT help
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/camera/camera-doesn-t-work-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows camera works in one app only

text:
Windows camera is black or missing
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: hardware / camera.
Symptom: No preview or camera unavailable
Possible causes (not confirmed): Obstruction or driver or hardware fault
Resolution:
1. Check privacy shutter
2. Restart
3. Test Camera app
4. Check camera device and approved driver updates
Verify: Camera preview returns
Escalate: Camera missing after supported checks requires service
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/camera/camera-doesn-t-work-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows camera is black or missing

text:
Windows stop error after a new peripheral
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / crashes.
Symptom: Stop screen after hardware addition
Possible causes (not confirmed): New hardware or associated driver
Resolution:
1. Record stop code
2. Shut down and disconnect the new external device
3. Restart
4. Check Device Manager and approved updates
Verify: Normal use no longer reproduces the crash
Escalate: Repeated failures need IT diagnosis
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/performance-optimization/troubleshooting-windows-unexpected-restarts-and-stop-code-errors

metadata.title: Windows stop error after a new peripheral

text:
Windows repeatedly crashes during startup
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / crashes.
Symptom: Repeated stop codes or restart loop
Possible causes (not confirmed): Driver or system issue
Resolution:
1. Record stop code and recent changes
2. Use supported recovery startup settings for Safe Mode if needed
3. Check Device Manager and free space
Verify: Startup and normal workload remain stable
Escalate: Unresolved crashes require support and diagnostic logs
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/performance-optimization/troubleshooting-windows-unexpected-restarts-and-stop-code-errors

metadata.title: Windows repeatedly crashes during startup

text:
Windows cannot boot into the desktop
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / os_recovery.
Symptom: Startup fails or loops
Possible causes (not confirmed): Startup corruption or recent system change
Resolution:
1. Protect available backups and recovery credentials
2. Enter supported Windows recovery
3. Start with the least disruptive applicable repair option
Verify: Windows reaches desktop and files are accessible
Escalate: If repair fails seek help before reset or reinstall
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/backup-recovery/recovery-options-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows cannot boot into the desktop

text:
Windows unstable after a recent change
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / os_recovery.
Symptom: New freezes or crashes
Possible causes (not confirmed): Recent software or system change
Resolution:
1. Identify change
2. Back up important files
3. Compare applicable recovery options and try least disruptive first
Verify: Previous failing workload succeeds
Escalate: Reset and reinstall need explicit data-loss review
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/backup-recovery/recovery-options-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows unstable after a recent change

text:
Bluetooth device will not pair
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / bluetooth.
Symptom: Pairing fails or Bluetooth unavailable
Possible causes (not confirmed): Connection settings or adapter issue
Resolution:
1. Run Bluetooth troubleshooter in Get Help
2. Follow the matching symptom guidance
3. Record adapter and peripheral model
Verify: Device pairs and performs its intended function
Escalate: Persistent missing adapter requires support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/bluetooth/fix-bluetooth-problems-in-windows

metadata.title: Bluetooth device will not pair

text:
Bluetooth headphones connected without sound
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / bluetooth_audio.
Symptom: Headphones paired but silent
Possible causes (not confirmed): Wrong output selection or driver issue
Resolution:
1. Select headphones as sound output
2. Check volume
3. Run Bluetooth troubleshooter
4. Remove and pair again if needed
Verify: Test audio plays in headphones
Escalate: Persistent failure requires adapter and headset compatibility review
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/bluetooth/fix-bluetooth-connected-but-no-sound-issue-on-windows

metadata.title: Bluetooth headphones connected without sound

text:
Bluetooth audio disconnects repeatedly
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / bluetooth_audio.
Symptom: Intermittent wireless playback
Possible causes (not confirmed): Driver or connection compatibility issue
Resolution:
1. Toggle Bluetooth
2. Pair the headset again
3. Check approved Bluetooth drivers and Windows updates
Verify: Playback remains connected during a test call
Escalate: Collect adapter and headset models for support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/bluetooth/fix-bluetooth-connected-but-no-sound-issue-on-windows

metadata.title: Bluetooth audio disconnects repeatedly

text:
Windows update fails with a driver-related error
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / updates.
Symptom: Update failure such as 0xC1900101
Possible causes (not confirmed): Possible incompatible driver
Resolution:
1. Record exact code and update
2. Run Windows Update troubleshooter
3. Review compatible model drivers
Verify: Update completes and restart succeeds
Escalate: Persisting code requires IT review
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-US/Windows/Deployment/Updates-Lifecycle/troubleshoot-problems-updating-windows

metadata.title: Windows update fails with a driver-related error

text:
Windows update reports configuration or file errors
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / updates.
Symptom: Update failure such as 0x80070057
Possible causes (not confirmed): Possible corrupted files or configuration
Resolution:
1. Record error
2. Back up important files
3. Run Windows Update troubleshooter
4. Escalate for supported system-file repair if unresolved
Verify: Update installs successfully
Escalate: Avoid ad hoc registry or system-folder deletion
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-US/Windows/Deployment/Updates-Lifecycle/troubleshoot-problems-updating-windows

metadata.title: Windows update reports configuration or file errors

text:
Windows update cannot proceed because storage is full
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / storage.
Symptom: Update requests more free storage
Possible causes (not confirmed): Insufficient disk space
Resolution:
1. Review Storage settings
2. Remove only reviewed unnecessary files or move backed-up personal data
3. Follow Windows Update space guidance
Verify: Update has sufficient space and completes
Escalate: Unknown files or insufficient capacity require support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/deployment/updates-lifecycle/free-up-space-for-windows-updates

metadata.title: Windows update cannot proceed because storage is full

text:
Windows malware returns after removal
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / security.
Symptom: Same threat detected after restart
Possible causes (not confirmed): Persistent component or repeat exposure
Resolution:
1. Update protection
2. Save work
3. Run Microsoft Defender Offline
4. Review results and avoid repeat exposure
Verify: Follow-up scans show no recurring detection
Escalate: Recurring threats or sensitive data exposure require security support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/defender/troubleshoot-problems-with-detecting-and-removing-malware

metadata.title: Windows malware returns after removal

text:
Microsoft Defender scan fails repeatedly
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / security.
Symptom: Scan or removal errors
Possible causes (not confirmed): Insufficient disk space or outdated components
Resolution:
1. Record error
2. Check available storage
3. Apply supported Windows and protection updates
4. Retry scan
Verify: Scan completes and remediation status is clear
Escalate: Persistent errors require security support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/defender/troubleshoot-problems-with-detecting-and-removing-malware

metadata.title: Microsoft Defender scan fails repeatedly

text:
External keyboard or mouse fails in Windows
Applies to: Windows 11; external devices. Category: hardware / input_devices.
Symptom: Peripheral does not respond
Possible causes (not confirmed): Device connection or driver issue
Resolution:
1. Check connection
2. Test device on another compatible PC
3. Check Windows Update and device driver
Verify: Input works consistently
Escalate: Device failing on multiple PCs may need replacement
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/input-devices/mouse-and-keyboard-problems-in-windows

metadata.title: External keyboard or mouse fails in Windows

text:
MacBook battery will not charge
Applies to: macOS; Mac laptops. Category: hardware / charging.
Symptom: Charging does not start
Possible causes (not confirmed): Adapter or battery or other hardware issue
Resolution:
1. Check compatible power adapter and cable
2. Inspect for damage
3. Use Apple Diagnostics guidance for the model
Verify: Charging status and battery level increase normally
Escalate: Damaged power accessories or persistent failure require Apple service
Source: https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/mac-help/-mh29198/mac

metadata.title: MacBook battery will not charge

text:
Mac shows flashing question mark at startup
Applies to: macOS. Category: software / mac_startup.
Symptom: Question mark during startup
Possible causes (not confirmed): Startup disk unavailable or not selected
Resolution:
1. Follow model-specific startup options
2. If a disk is available select it
3. Set the correct Startup Disk after successful boot
Verify: Mac starts from the intended disk
Escalate: Missing or unrepairable disk requires service
Source: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/if-your-mac-stops-or-delays-while-starting-up-mchlp2580/mac

metadata.title: Mac shows flashing question mark at startup

text:
Mac delays at the startup progress bar
Applies to: macOS. Category: software / mac_startup.
Symptom: Startup progress takes longer than expected
Possible causes (not confirmed): macOS may be checking storage
Resolution:
1. Allow the disk check time
2. If startup remains stuck follow Apple startup troubleshooting
3. Record exact screen
Verify: Startup completes and normal access returns
Escalate: Persistent stall requires disk or startup diagnosis
Source: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/if-your-mac-stops-or-delays-while-starting-up-mchlp2580/mac

metadata.title: Mac delays at the startup progress bar

text:
Mac storage has filesystem errors
Applies to: macOS. Category: software / filesystem.
Symptom: Disk Utility reports storage errors
Possible causes (not confirmed): Filesystem or directory inconsistency
Resolution:
1. Back up accessible files
2. Follow Apple guidance to run Disk Utility First Aid
3. Use macOS Recovery when required for startup disk repair
Verify: First Aid succeeds and files are accessible
Escalate: Failed repair requires support before erase or replacement
Source: https://support.apple.com/en-lamr/102611

metadata.title: Mac storage has filesystem errors

text:
Ubuntu laptop has Wi-Fi turned off
Applies to: Ubuntu desktop with NetworkManager. Category: software / networking.
Symptom: No wireless connection
Possible causes (not confirmed): Airplane mode or wireless switch disabled
Resolution:
1. Check physical wireless switch if present
2. Enable Wi-Fi and disable airplane mode
3. Inspect nmcli device output
Verify: Wireless adapter shows connected after joining network
Escalate: Missing adapter needs hardware and driver diagnosis
Source: https://help.ubuntu.com/stable/ubuntu-help/net-wireless-troubleshooting-initial-check.html.te

metadata.title: Ubuntu laptop has Wi-Fi turned off

text:
Ubuntu cannot establish wireless connectivity
Applies to: Ubuntu desktop. Category: software / networking.
Symptom: Cannot connect to wireless network
Possible causes (not confirmed): Adapter or connection or router issue
Resolution:
1. Follow initial checks
2. Gather hardware details
3. Check adapter detection
4. Attempt router connection
5. Check modem and router
Verify: Network connection and internet access work
Escalate: Escalate with Ubuntu release and wireless chipset
Source: https://help.ubuntu.com/stable/ubuntu-help/net-wireless-troubleshooting.html.en

metadata.title: Ubuntu cannot establish wireless connectivity

text:
Windows external monitor is not detected
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: hardware / display.
Symptom: External display absent
Possible causes (not confirmed): Cable or adapter or display mode issue
Resolution:
1. Select Extend with Windows plus P
2. Check cable
3. Test another cable and monitor on another computer
4. Bypass dock where possible
Verify: External screen appears and remains stable
Escalate: Persistent fault requires port and graphics review
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/hardware/display-graphics/troubleshoot-external-monitor-connections-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows external monitor is not detected

text:
External display stopped after a driver update
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / graphics_driver.
Symptom: Previously working display fails after update
Possible causes (not confirmed): Possible display driver regression
Resolution:
1. Restart
2. Try Windows plus Ctrl plus Shift plus B
3. Use Device Manager driver rollback if available and appropriate
Verify: External display returns
Escalate: Unavailable rollback or ongoing failure requires support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/hardware/display-graphics/troubleshoot-external-monitor-connections-in-windows

metadata.title: External display stopped after a driver update

text:
Windows speakers or headphones have no sound
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / audio.
Symptom: Silent output
Possible causes (not confirmed): Wrong output or mute or loose connection
Resolution:
1. Select intended output
2. Check system and application volume
3. Check cables and headphones
4. Run audio troubleshooter
Verify: Test sound plays through intended output
Escalate: Persistent failure requires driver or hardware diagnosis
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/audio/fix-sound-or-audio-problems-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows speakers or headphones have no sound

text:
Windows audio sounds distorted
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / audio.
Symptom: Poor or abnormal playback
Possible causes (not confirmed): Audio enhancement issue
Resolution:
1. Check selected output and connections
2. Turn audio enhancements off for that output
3. Run audio troubleshooter
Verify: Same audio plays normally
Escalate: Persistent distortion requires support
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/audio/fix-sound-or-audio-problems-in-windows

metadata.title: Windows audio sounds distorted

text:
Windows asks for a BitLocker recovery key
Applies to: Windows 11. Category: software / disk_encryption.
Symptom: Encrypted drive locked at startup
Possible causes (not confirmed): Security or hardware change can trigger recovery
Resolution:
1. Record recovery key ID
2. Locate matching key in Microsoft account or work or school account or saved backup
3. Enter it locally
4. Contact organization IT if managed
Verify: Drive unlocks and startup completes
Escalate: A lost key cannot be recreated by Microsoft; reset removes files
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/encryption/find-your-bitlocker-recovery-key

metadata.title: Windows asks for a BitLocker recovery key
